name: @monark/rpc-guard
description: MONARK single budgeted RPC client (GARDE-HELIUS). One handle owns every paid endpoint: call(label, method, params) resolves label->private URL internally, meters credits by a closed per-operator tariff, ledgers each attempt write-ahead to a chained durable cycle ledger, and fail-closes on three caps (run, method, cycle). No exported symbol ever returns an endpoint URL. ADR-GARDE-HELIUS.
